title: Toddler Nutrition 12–24 Months: Joining Family Meals Safely
excerpt: Transitioning to family meals, limiting added sugar and salt, and keeping portions age-appropriate
content:
## Introduction to Toddler Nutrition 12–24 Months
Toddler nutrition 12–24 months plays a crucial role in the development and growth of children. During this phase, children start joining family meals and require essential nutrients to ensure overall development.
## Transitioning to Family Meals
To transition to family meals for toddlers 12–24 months, parents should note the following:
- Start with simple, easy-to-digest foods
- Gradually transition from solid to liquid foods
- Limit foods high in added sugar and salt
- Ensure adequate hydration
## Limiting Added Sugar and Salt
Limiting added sugar and salt is vital in toddler nutrition 12–24 months. Parents should note the following:
- Limit foods high in added sugar and salt
- Choose products without added sugar and salt
- Read food labels to understand sugar and salt content
## Keeping Portions Age-Appropriate
Keeping portions age-appropriate is crucial to ensure children receive adequate nutrients. Parents should note the following:
- Provide 3-4 main meals and 2-3 snacks per day
- Ensure children eat a variety of fruits, vegetables, protein, and whole grains
- Limit foods high in fat, sugar, and salt
## Conclusion
Toddler nutrition 12–24 months is essential for the development and growth of children. Parents should note the above guidelines to ensure children receive adequate nutrients and develop properly.
